summary: The account03/B07 r15 constant area-bank mass cannot in general be collapsed to one pair-containing coordinate packet with a dimension-free determinant. For U_N with rows sqrt(3/4)e1, sqrt(1/2)e2, (1/2)e1, (1/sqrt(2))e2, and N copies N^(-1/2)e3, the r15 pair has ell=3/4, m=1/2, g=3/8 while each nonzero pair-containing triple has squared volume 3/(8N) and their aggregate is exactly 3/8. The symmetric target A_N=[[0,U_N],[U_N^T,0]] has eigenvalues +1,+1,+1,-1,-1,-1 plus zeros, so this is target-valid. It refutes only single-packet extraction, not QFORM; the same report proves a rank-r cross-fiber Plancherel theorem that uniformly pays this stress.
